description: This file defines the FilterParser class responsible for parsing filter expressions in the SuiteCRM JSON API filter component. It includes methods for parsing filter keys and values, handling nested field structures, and managing filter operators.

classes.name: FilterParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing filter expressions, including nested fields and operators, in the SuiteCRM JSON API filter implementation.

methods.name: parseFilter
methods.description: Main entry point to parse a filter key-value pair into a structured filter representation.

methods.name: parseFieldKey
methods.description: Parses a filter key, possibly a nested field, into a nested array structure.

methods.name: splitFieldKeys
methods.description: Splits a dotted field name into a nested tree structure, validating each segment.

methods.name: parseFieldFilter
methods.description: Parses filter values, handling operators and operands, into a structured array.

methods.name: splitValues
methods.description: Splits a string of comma-separated values into an array.

methods.name: isInOperatorsArray
methods.description: Checks if a given operator string matches any operator in a provided list.

methods.name: stringDifference
methods.description: Computes the character difference between two strings.

methods.name: mergeValueToFilterKey
methods.description: Merges filter values into the parsed filter key structure, supporting nested filters.
